problem_type: Anchored composer placement collapses to zero height when its anchor fills the usable viewport
symptom: The core canvas lifecycle test reports a zero-height placement, leaving the composer unmeasurable and unusable at the fit-view boundary.
direct_cause: resolveAnchoredPlacement clamps both aboveSpace and belowSpace to zero and uses the selected side space as the only height source when minHeight is omitted.
class_root: The shared placement boundary had no fallback that preserved natural content height when an anchor consumed all available side space.
affected_population: Composer overlays anchored to a node that touches both usable viewport edges
Fit-view and small-window layouts where the selected node fills the stage
internal_only_reason: The invariant is an application-owned geometry contract; no dependency behavior determines the fallback height.
invariants: A non-degenerate usable stage and positive natural content height produce a positive in-stage placement height even when the anchor leaves no side space.

door_reduction.why_not: The two consumers must remain separate because AgentPanelV4Context and useComposerViewportPlacement own different host lifecycles; both now converge on the same resolveAnchoredPlacement boundary. The type declarations are local reads required by the shared contract.

generality_proof: Both production consumers call the same pure resolver, and the resolver derives the fallback from the supplied stage and natural height rather than from a caller, host, or viewport size. Any anchor geometry that exhausts both side spaces therefore receives the same positive in-stage fallback.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Choose side, clamp dimensions, and preserve measurable natural content height inside the usable stage.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: This consumer calls resolveAnchoredPlacement for the resident Agent panel composer and inherits the shared fallback.
This consumer calls the same resolver for canvas node composers and therefore receives the same full-stage behavior.

recurrence.reason: The geometry is shared by multiple hosts and can recur for any viewport, zoom, dock, or anchor combination that leaves no side space.
same_class_scan: Checked AgentPanelV4Context.tsx and useComposerViewportPlacement.ts as the two production consumers.
Checked anchoredPlacement.test.ts and coreCanvasLifecycle.test.ts for edge and full-stage geometry coverage.

prevention.invariant: When the usable stage has positive height, resolved height is at least the natural height clamped to that stage whenever both side spaces are zero.
prevention.failure_mode: A degenerate stage still resolves to zero dimensions; a valid stage never returns a zero-height natural composer solely because the anchor fills it.
prevention.strategy: Keep the fallback in the pure shared resolver so every host and every future caller receives the same geometry rule.

legacy_paths.rationale: The resolver remains the single placement path; this change only closes its missing full-stage branch.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The failure is in the application geometry invariant and does not depend on a third-party runtime.

migration: No persisted data or caller contract changes; all callers continue using the same resolver signature.
residual_risks: Visual confirmation is covered by the golden-path Electron run; packaged macOS visual evidence remains part of the release lane.

invariant_owner_layer.why: The pure resolver is the single owner of side-space clamping and natural composer height; both its direct geometry tests and the lifecycle consumer test exercise the invariant.
